sections.title: About the hotel
sections.body:
Olympos Garden Hotel is a three-star hotel in Kocatepe, Beyoğlu. Taksim Square and İstiklal Street are a five-minute walk; the metro and airport bus stops are the same distance.

Rooms have air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and daily housekeeping. Breakfast and parking are included in the room rate.

Book directly with us and you pay no booking-site commission; your questions go straight to the front desk.

items.author: Sebahat E.
items.text: Great location, very comfortable beds, very clean. The room was cleaned whenever we asked. Tea, coffee and water are unlimited.

sections.title: Rooms
sections.intro: Three room types. For current rates and availability, send us your dates on WhatsApp.

items.name: Triple Room
items.description: One large and one single bed. For families and groups of three.

items.name: Parking
items.description: Free for the length of your stay.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-out is at 11:00. We confirm the check-in time when you book.

items.q: How do I get to the hotel from the airport?
items.a: Havaist buses from Istanbul Airport and Havabus from Sabiha Gökçen both stop at Taksim. From Taksim the hotel is a five-minute walk. For a taxi or transfer, message us on WhatsApp.
Yes. Parking is free for the length of your stay.

You pay the hotel directly at check-in, in cash or by card.

sections.title: Getting here
sections.note: Feridiye Street No:106, Kocatepe. Taksim Square and Taksim metro station are a five-minute walk. Free parking if you arrive by car.
